caseName: Koch Oil Co. v. Committee of Creditors Holding Unsecured Claims Against Powerine Oil Co.
caseNameFull: KOCH OIL COMPANY v. COMMITTEE OF CREDITORS HOLDING UNSECURED CLAIMS AGAINST POWERINE OIL COMPANY, DEBTOR IN BANKRUPTCY

opinions.text: Motion of U.S. Council on International Banking, Inc. for leave to file a brief as amicus cwriae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
